test_cases.claim: Regulated entities must submit annual compliance disclosures within 30 days after fiscal year end.
test_cases.evidence_text: 1.1 Mandatory Deadline: All regulated entities must complete and submit their annual compliance disclosures within 30 days following the conclusion of the fiscal year.

test_cases.claim: All annual filings must be submitted electronically through the EDGAR-Plus gateway.
test_cases.evidence_text: 1.2 Electronic Submission: All annual filings must be transmitted exclusively through the secure electronic regulatory gateway (EDGAR-Plus). Physical paper submissions are prohibited.

test_cases.claim: Physical paper submissions of compliance filings are strictly prohibited.

test_cases.claim: The statutory base civil penalty for late filing violations is $50,000 per violation.
test_cases.evidence_text: 2.1 Late Filing Penalties: Any entity failing to meet the 30-day submission deadline is subject to a statutory base civil penalty of $15,000 per violation, plus $500 for each subsequent day of delay.

test_cases.claim: Paper submissions are accepted if submitted with a written waiver.

test_cases.claim: Entities are required to undergo bi-monthly environmental emissions audits.
test_cases.evidence_text: 3.1 Small Enterprise Exemption: Commercial enterprises with an aggregate gross annual revenue of less than $2.5 million are explicitly exempt from mandatory quarterly third-party audit verifications.
